review_notes: I read the whole file and checked downstream uses. δ_injective is used in PairingCore.lean:192, and injective_map is used only inside this file. The refactor creates no dependency cycle, because injective_map does not use δ_injective. The duplication is small, about three lines, so the benefit is modest. I confirmed the candidate because both lemmas prove the same fact: a nondegenerate simplex in a nonsingular set determines a simplex-category map from its image under X.map. I have not compiled the rewrite. The main elaboration risk is the definitional unfolding of X.δ, and the candidate already gives fallbacks. I found no other repeated machinery in the file; the remaining proofs are short and have different hypotheses.

claims.reason: Nonsingular.δ_injective and Nonsingular.injective_map both get `Mono (yonedaEquiv.symm x)` from `Nonsingular.mono'`. Both then use it to show that two simplex-category maps into ⦋n⦌ with equal image `X.map _.op x` are equal. δ_injective does this by hand, with `objEquiv.symm` and `(yonedaEquiv.symm x).app _`. injective_map does it with `cancel_mono` and `yonedaEquiv`. SimplicialObject.δ is defined as `X.map (SimplexCategory.δ i).op`. So `X.δ i x = X.δ j x` is, up to unfolding, the hypothesis of injective_map with m := ⦋n⦌, f := δ i, g := δ j, at dimension n+1. injective_map does not depend on δ_injective, so moving it earlier creates no cycle. The assumptions are unchanged: `[X.Nonsingular]` and `hx : x ∈ X.nonDegenerate _`. The shared lemma already exists, so the change is a reorder plus a one-line corollary. The duplication is small, but it is real and the cleanup is credible.
claims.shared_lemma: lemma Nonsingular.injective_map [X.Nonsingular] {n : ℕ} (x : X _⦋n⦌) (hx : x ∈ X.nonDegenerate n) {m : SimplexCategory} {f g : m ⟶ ⦋n⦌} (h : X.map f.op x = X.map g.op x) : f = g  -- existing statement, moved above δ_injective
rewritten_uses: lemma Nonsingular.δ_injective [X.Nonsingular] {n : ℕ} (x : X _⦋n + 1⦌) (hx : x ∈ X.nonDegenerate _) (i j : Fin (n + 2)) (hij : X.δ i x = X.δ j x) : i = j := SimplexCategory.δ_injective (injective_map x hx hij)
injective_map's own use in N.existsUnique_of_le is unchanged: Nonsingular.injective_map _ y.nonDegenerate (by rw [hf₁, hf₂])
